description:
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}
Oltec Matterweaver triggers, creating a 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens plus at least one additional artifact token due to Tippy-Toe.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing two artifact tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
